seo.description: Fit-only Porcelanosa large-format porcelain installation in Gerrards Cross, from £3,500. You buy the tile through a showroom or stockist, we handle strip-out, prep, tiling and plumbing.

hero.intro: Gerrards Cross sits roughly 25 to 30 minutes by road from our Bracknell base, and it's one of the more affluent commuter villages we cover, close to Beaconsfield and Chalfont St Peter. Properties here vary more in age and layout than a single architectural era would suggest, which matters for a Porcelanosa installation more than it might for some other work: Porcelanosa's dense, rectified porcelain doesn't care whether the floor underneath it belongs to a Victorian joist structure, a 1930s build or a recent extension — it needs the same flat, level, well-prepared substrate regardless, because the tile itself has so little tolerance for showing up the difference. We work fit-only in Gerrards Cross — you source your Porcelanosa tiles, sanitaryware and brassware, and we strip out, first-fix, tile, plumb and snag, from £3,500.

sections.heading: What Porcelanosa is known for, and what we install
sections.body: Porcelanosa's reputation rests largely on its large-format porcelain tiling: dense, rectified to a tight tolerance, and dimensionally precise in a way that gives a noticeably cleaner, tighter joint than a standard pressed tile. That's the product we fit most often from the brand across Gerrards Cross bathrooms and en-suites — full-height wall runs, floor tiling through wet rooms and walk-in showers, and the kind of large-slab flooring that's become a common specification in more recently renovated properties. The appeal is obvious once it's on the wall or floor: fewer, larger joints read as calmer and more considered than a grid of smaller tiles. Getting that calm, considered look in practice depends entirely on what happens underneath it before the tile is ever cut.

sections.heading: Why substrate preparation matters more with this tile
sections.body: Because Porcelanosa's porcelain is manufactured to such a tight tolerance, it has almost no give to absorb an uneven floor or wall the way a smaller, slightly irregular tile can. We start every Porcelanosa installation with a flatness check across the substrate, correcting any dip or hump with levelling compound or packing before tiling begins. From there, the tile is set with full bed coverage rather than spot-bonding, a consistent joint width held with the correct spacers, and close attention to lippage — making sure one tile edge sits flush with its neighbour rather than catching the light, or a bare foot, at a slightly different height. None of that changes because a property is older or newer; what changes is how much preparation the existing substrate needs before it's ready, and that's exactly what we assess at survey stage before any tile is ordered or fitted.

sections.heading: Fit-only, from survey to snagging
sections.body: We don't supply Porcelanosa products ourselves — you choose and buy them, and our quote covers the installation only. That begins with a £125 survey to check the substrate and confirm sizes and layout, followed by fit-only installation from £3,500 covering strip-out, preparation, tiling, plumbing and snagging. We've been fitting bathrooms across Berkshire and the surrounding commuter belt, including Gerrards Cross, for 30 years. If you've got a Porcelanosa bathroom specified for a Gerrards Cross property, get in touch to arrange a survey.

faqs.q: Is Porcelanosa supplied as part of your installation service?
faqs.a: No — we work fit-only. You buy your Porcelanosa tiles, sanitaryware and brassware yourself, through a showroom or Porcelanosa's own stockists, and we quote purely for the installation.

faqs.q: Does the age of a Gerrards Cross property affect how Porcelanosa tiling is fitted?
faqs.a: It affects how much preparation the substrate needs rather than the fitting method itself. Porcelanosa's dense, rectified porcelain needs a flat, level surface with full bed coverage and controlled lippage whether the floor beneath it is original to an older property or part of a recent extension.

faqs.q: How far is Gerrards Cross from your base?
faqs.a: Gerrards Cross is around 25 to 30 minutes by road from our base in Bracknell, and it's a village we cover regularly.

faqs.q: Do you repair existing Porcelanosa tiling?
faqs.a: Yes, from £200, with a £500 minimum for emergency call-outs. We don't carry out standalone regrouting as a service by itself.
